name: Honoyasei Ember
source:
Tomboy, lone-wolf jock and delinquent... those would be the nicest things people would say about Ember. She can be imposing with her towering stature and loud voice, but dig a bit deeper and you'll find an enthusiastic leader, a passionate friend and an awkward girl that can run her mouth a hundred miles a second!

Despite having an overbearing presence, Ember hides demons of her own. Seemingly a magnet for trouble, will her unanswered questions drive you away or bring you two together?

[From [url=https://flutteringabyss.itch.io/missingtime]Itch.io[/url]]
